questions.prompt: A teacher asks whether you are a student. Answer for yourself, then ask a peer the corresponding familiar identity question.
questions.context:
A teacher asks whether you are a student. In this scene you are a student; the peer next to you has not stated their role. Answer the teacher, then ask the peer whether they are a student and pause for their reply.
Familiar meanings available: teacher; student; schoolchild; you, used respectfully; you.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: I answered the question that was asked.
I changed speaker and listener roles when asking my question.

questions.prompt: Write a short identification for a group of students and distinguish the teacher from that group.
questions.context:
You and the classmates receiving this message are students. The teacher is a teacher, separate from your group. Write a group identification that preserves those two roles.
Familiar meanings available: we; us; student; schoolchild; teacher; be.
questions.label: Write your own message

rubric.text: My message identifies the group and its role.
The teacher and students are not assigned the same role by accident.
